title: Namecheap Hosting Review 2026: Plans, Prices, Speed Tests and AI Tools
excerpt: Namecheap hosting starts at $2.28 a month, but renewal is about double. Here is how fast it was in six independent tests, how reliable it is, and who should skip it.

meta._yoast_wpseo_title: Namecheap Hosting Review 2026: Prices, Speed, AI Tools
meta._yoast_wpseo_metadesc: Namecheap hosting review for 2026: plan prices and renewals, speed and uptime from six independent tests, AI tools, pros and cons, and who should avoid it.
meta.rl_answer: Namecheap hosting is a cheap, good fit for small sites near the US. Independent tests measured 99.29% to 100% uptime, slower speeds in Asia and a renewal price about double the promo.
meta.rl_faqs:
Is Namecheap good for hosting? | It is good for a small site near the US. Cybernews called it a great domain provider and weak web hosting.
Is Namecheap fast? | Close to the US, yes: TopSiteHosters measured a 232 ms time to first byte. Far from the US it is slower: Cyber Naira measured 1.1 seconds in Asia Pacific without a CDN.
How much does Namecheap hosting cost? | Stellar starts at $2.28 a month. It renews at $55.88 a year, or $5.88 a month on monthly billing.
Does Namecheap offer a free trial? | Yes. It lists 30 days free on shared hosting. The 30-day money-back guarantee does not apply with the free period.
How reliable is Namecheap hosting? | Independent tests measured between 99.29% and 100% uptime. Namecheap advertises 100%.
Does Namecheap have phone support? | Namecheap lists 24/7 live chat and tickets. HostingGuider could not confirm phone support.
Does Namecheap have email hosting? | Yes. Stellar includes 30 mailboxes. Stellar Plus and Business include unlimited mailboxes.
Can I host more than three sites on Stellar? | No. Stellar covers 3 sites. Stellar Plus and Business allow unlimited sites.
Does Namecheap include a free domain? | HostingGuider reports it does not. Check the plan page at checkout.
Is Namecheap good for WordPress? | Yes for small sites. WordPress installs in one click, and Namecheap lists AI for WordPress. Use a CDN for visitors far from the US.
Does Namecheap have AI tools? | Yes. It lists AI for WordPress and Sitejet AI Website Builder on every shared plan.
Is Namecheap better than Hostinger? | Hostinger measured faster and more consistent in tests, with a lower renewal price. Namecheap keeps domains and hosting in one account.

meta.rl_takeaways:
Stellar starts at $2.28 a month and renews at $55.88 a year.
Independent tests measured 99.29% to 100% uptime against a 100% claim.
Asia Pacific averaged 1.1 seconds to first byte without a CDN.
Namecheap lists a 30-day free period and a 30-day refund, but not together.
meta.rl_r_verdict: Namecheap hosting is a good, cheap start for a small site with visitors near the US. Speed drops in Asia and South America without a CDN, uptime measured below the 100% claim, and renewal is about double. Choose it for the domain and hosting in one place.
meta.rl_r_buy:
You run a small site, a portfolio or a first blog.
Most of your visitors are in North America or Europe.
You want domains and hosting in one account.
meta.rl_r_skip:
Your audience is mostly in Asia or South America and you will not use a CDN.
You need strong security tools or phone support.
You want a low price for years.
meta.rl_r_pros:
Low promo prices from $2.28 a month.
A 30-day free period, and a 30-day refund.
Unmetered bandwidth, free SSL and a free CDN tier.
AI for WordPress and an AI site builder.
Fast results near the US in several tests.
meta.rl_r_cons:
Renewal is about 2 to 2.4 times the promo price.
Slow for far-away visitors without a CDN.
Measured uptime below the 100% claim.
Limited malware protection, according to Cybernews.
No phone support confirmed.
meta.rl_r_best: Small sites with visitors near the US
meta.rl_r_method:
Our own use | We do not host our websites with Namecheap, so this review rests on published data. Each test is credited to its publisher
Pricing and terms | Namecheap's shared hosting page, read on 15 and 16 November 2026: plan prices, renewals, limits, the free period and the guarantee
Independent tests | Cybernews, TopSiteHosters, HostingGuider, Cyber Naira, Kripesh Adwani and HostingTestLab, each with its method and date shown in the table
Competitor reviews | Five top-ranking Namecheap reviews read, and their questions compared
Our calculations | The renewal multiples are our own arithmetic from Namecheap's prices
When sources disagree | We show both numbers. For prices we use Namecheap's own page
Freshness | Prices and offers are read again before this page goes live
What we did not do | We did not run our own speed or uptime test
